 HILLSBOROUGH COUNTY, Fla. (CBS12) — More than 50 people were arrested following an undercover operation to identify and arrest unlicensed contractors in Hillsborough County, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office .
 HCSO says that from Jun. 1 through Oct. 2, its Property Division detectives within the Construction Fraud Unit made 50 arrests as they aim to protect homeowners from fraud, and unsafe work.
 Some of these false contractors are convicted felons with lengthy criminal histories, according to HCSO.
 See also: More than 4.3 million toothpaste tubes recalled, including children's brands 
 “A contractor’s license is more than a piece of paper. It is proof that the person working on your home has the training to do the job safely,” said Sheriff Chad Chronister. “When someone with no license and no training touches your wiring, your roof, or your home’s foundation, they are putting your family in danger. This operation was about more than arrests. It was about protecting your home and the people you love.”
